purpose: task achievement facts inside the main world page round log, with the committed goal text

flow.world: isolated SQLite at artifacts/next-runs/task-display-r1/world.db, created by the page itself
commands: 完成压力试验（任务已消耗，规则拒绝）
flow.why: the first command achieves task_pressure in the corridor, so its goal can be read back from the committed point

taskFact.shape: subject + 达成任务： + the committed goal verbatim
taskFact.shown: 周宁达成任务：完成压力试验。
taskFact.source: characters.person_c.tasks.task_pressure.goal and .status at point_7, after the delta applied
taskFact.notUsed: the delta carries only task IDs; no goal text and no execution detail is taken from the command

verification.derives: expected fragments from world_points plus the committed checkpoint tasks, not from the adapter

pageCheck.beforeAndAfterRefresh: every round identical, including the task sentence

historyStable.lastRound:
周宁从走廊到门厅。

来源

coverage.taskAchieved: real command 完成压力试验; goal shown verbatim from committed state; no unshown hint
coverage.taskGoalFromDelta: not possible: tasksAchieved holds IDs only
coverage.subtaskAdded: adapter sentence implemented and unit-tested against a committed-state fixture; no normal command produces subtasksAdded, so no page-level acceptance
coverage.move: 2 rounds, origin and destination both shown
coverage.emptyDelta: rule refusal left an empty delta, shown as 没有实体变化
coverage.root: no change claim on the root point
coverage.appearanceNotReachable: still open: the rule vocabulary emits no appearanceChanges
